snippet.title: StackZap - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
StackZap is a game about stacking up differently colored balls in rows, columns and diagonals of 3 or more of the same color. You get points not for clearing them, but based on a distance that the remaining balls fall. There are 5 colors of the balls: red, green, blue, yellow, gray. The game is over when any of the balls is outside the play field.

Developed by Xitilon
